text.title: 半路停下的小车
text.situation:
一辆极小的小车沿短轨道行驶。乔先看机械结构静图，再按动态图旁的按钮。链条连接运动部件。字幕把小车运动与动能联系，邻板介绍动力学，即研究运动及相关力的学科。另一封闭模型用液压把脆性样本压成碎块。演示到半途，小车似乎故障停下，工作人员断开它。屏幕关闭前，玛雅查看解释动量的质量和速度说明。

乔：它故障了吗？
工作人员：它意外停了，我们会检查后再启动。
玛雅：液压模型能继续吗？
工作人员：那是独立展示，请留在玻璃这边。

paragraphs.en: A tiny trolley moved along a short track. Jo first saw a static drawing of its mechanism, then pressed the button beside a dynamic display. A chain connected the moving parts. The caption linked the trolley’s motion to kinetic energy, and a nearby board introduced kinetics as the study of motion and the forces involved. Another enclosed model used hydraulic pressure to crush a brittle sample into pieces. Halfway through the demonstration, the trolley seemed to break down and stopped. The attendant disconnected it. Maya looked at the mass and speed notes that explained momentum before the screen was switched off.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Did it break down?
Attendant: It has stopped unexpectedly. We will check it before restarting.
Maya: Can the hydraulic model continue?
Attendant: That display is separate. Please stay on this side of the glass.
